tools.name: estimate_admission_chances
tools.description: Estimate a student's chance of admission at one U.S. college from their GPA, test scores and context. Returns the percentage, a Reach/Target/Likely/Safety verdict, what would move the number, the school's federal admissions data, and a link to the full calculator.

tools.name: estimate_college_list
tools.description: Score one student profile against up to 15 colleges at once. Returns every school sorted by chance with its verdict, the Reach/Target/Likely balance, the chance of at least one acceptance, and concrete advice to balance the list.

tools.name: search_colleges
tools.description: Find U.S. colleges by name, state, public/private, and acceptance-rate range. Give a SAT score to rank schools by how close the student sits to each school's 75th percentile. Returns names to pass to the estimate tools.

tools.name: get_school_admissions_data
tools.description: Federal admissions and outcome data for one U.S. college: applicants, admits, yield, SAT/ACT middle 50%, test policy, cost, net price after aid, graduation rate and earnings, plus the estimated chance for typical GPA and SAT combinations at that school. No student profile needed.

tools.name: find_colleges_for_score
tools.description: Answer "what colleges can I get into with a ___": buckets every covered U.S. college into safety, target, reach and high reach for one SAT, ACT or unweighted GPA, using each college's real admitted-score data. Optional state filter. Returns counts and example colleges per tier.
